tool.name: BuildModel
tool.description: : Build a Molecular Dynamics AutoEncoder (MDAE) PyTorch model.

param.name: input_stats_pt_path
param.label: input PT file
param.help: Path to the input model statistics file. Format: [input].pt

param.name: outname_output_model_pth_path
param.label: output PTH name
param.help: Path to save the model in .pth format Format: [output].pth

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: model_type
param.label: model_type
param.help: Name of the model class to instantiate (must exist in biobb_pytorch.mdae.models).

param.name: encoder_layers
param.label: encoder_layers
param.help: List of integers representing the number of neurons in each encoder layer. (Json)

param.name: decoder_layers
param.label: decoder_layers
param.help: List of integers representing the number of neurons in each decoder layer. (Json)

param.name: options
param.label: options
param.help: Additional options (e.g. norm_in, optimizer, loss_function, device, etc.). (Json)
